title: UGC agency for small DTC brands, 20% commission

source.text: A UGC agency that connects small DTC brands with creators who film product videos, 20% commission. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 15 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug ugc-agency.

problem: Small DTC brands need a steady flow of product videos for ads and struggle to find and manage creators
solution: An agency that matches brands with creators who film product videos
assumptions: Price is 20% commission on the creator fee, about $175 per video, so about $35 per video
A small DTC brand buys 3-5 videos a month
Main channel is cold email (no channel was named)
Coordination takes 1.5-2 h per video (brief, product shipping, 2 revisions)
US card fee assumed at 2.9% + $0.30 (not verified on the US Stripe page)
